function inner() { |_|return 1;|R| }

function returnInTry() {
  try {
    |D|debugger;
    |_|return |C|inner();|R|
  } finally {
    |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
  }
}

function debuggerInFinally() {
  try {
    |_|return |C|inner();|R|
  } finally {
    |D|debugger;
  }
}

function returnFromForOf() {
  for (const |_|x of |_|[1, 2]) {
    |D|debugger;
    |_|return x;|R|
  }
|R|}

function returnFromUsing() {
  using r = |_|{[Symbol.dispose]() {|R|}};
  |D|debugger;
  |_|return 1;|R|
}

function nestedTryFinally() {
  try {
    try {
      |D|debugger;
      |_|return |C|inner();|R|
    } finally {
      |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
    }
  } finally {
    |_|globalThis.seen = 2;
  }
}

function twoReturns(x) {
  try {
    |D|debugger;
    |_|if (x) |_|return 1;
    |_|return 2;|R|
  } finally {
    |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
  }
}

function fallThrough(x) {
  try {
    |_|if (x) |_|return 1;|R|
  } finally {
    |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
  }
|R|}  // fallThrough end

async function asyncReturnInTry() {
  try {
    |D|debugger;
    |_|return 1;|R|
  } finally {
    |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
  }
}

function* gen() {
  try {
    |_|yield 1;
  } finally {
    |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
  }
|R|}  // gen end

function* genWithReturn() {
  try {
    |_|yield 1;
    |_|return 2;|R|
  } finally {
    |D|debugger;
  }
}

    |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
  }
}

// The body of every async generator is wrapped in an implicit finally block.

  |D|debugger;
  |_|return 1;|R|
}

  |D|debugger;
  |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
|R|}

  |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
|R|}  // asyncGenWithYield end

class Derived extends Base {
  constructor() {
    |C|super();
    try {
      |D|debugger;
      |_|return;|_|
    } finally {
      |_|globalThis.seen = 1;
    }
  |R|}
}

    |C|super();

    |_|return;|_|
  |R|}
}

function call(f, ...args) {
  const result = |C|f(...args);
  return result;|R|
}

function construct(C) {
  const result = |C|new C();
  return result;|R|
}

async function awaitNext(g) {
  const result = await g.|C|next();
  |_|return result;|R|
}

function drain(g) {
  const values = |_|[...g];
  return values;|R|
}

function returnEarly(g) {
  g.|C|next();
  const result = g.|_|return|C|(42);
  return result;|R|
}

async function drainAsync(g) {
  const values = |_|[];
  for await (const |_|value of |_|g) values.|C|push(value);
  |_|return values;|R|
}

async function returnEarlyAsync(g) {
  await g.|C|next();
  const result = await g.|_|return|C|(42);
  |_|return result;|R|
}
